TextBlock.Text: COMANDANTE DE LA FLOTA DE MAR
CARRIERS AT WAR - STRIKE AGAINST THE BRITISH CARRIER

StackPanel.TextBlock: 1. SITUATION: A BRITISH CARRIER GROUP, BELIEVED TO INCLUDE HMS INVINCIBLE, HAS BEEN REPORTED NORTHEAST OF THE MALVINAS. ITS CURRENT POSITION AND DISPOSITION REQUIRE CONFIRMATION. GT 79.1 IS APPROACHING FROM THE NORTHWEST WHILE LAND-BASED STRIKE AIRCRAFT APPROACH FROM THE SOUTH.

2. MISSION: GRUPO DE TAREAS 79.1, CENTRED ON ARA 25 DE MAYO, IS TO SINK HMS INVINCIBLE. KEEP 25 DE MAYO AFLOAT THROUGHOUT THE ACTION AND FOR THIRTY MINUTES AFTER THE BRITISH CARRIER IS SUNK. MAINTAIN THE ESCORT SCREEN AND FIGHTER COVER WHILE RECOVERING THE STRIKE.

3. EXECUTION: USE THE S-2 TRACKER TO LOCATE THE ENEMY AND CONFIRM THE CARRIER POSITION. CONCENTRATE THE EMBARKED A-4QS FOR THE MAIN STRIKE. COORDINATE THEIR APPROACH WITH ALA FLIGHT, TWO SUPER ETENDARDS ARMED WITH EXOCET MISSILES, AND ZONDA FLIGHT, TWO A-4PS EACH CARRYING TWO MK 83 BOMBS AND A CENTRELINE FUEL TANK. DIRECT THE ATTACK AGAINST THE CARRIER RATHER THAN DISPERSING IT AMONG THE ESCORTS.

MAINTAIN FIGHTER COVER AND THE ESCORT SCREEN AROUND 25 DE MAYO. SAN LUIS IS POSITIONED AHEAD OF THE FORCE TO INTERCEPT THE BRITISH GROUP. KEEP FRIENDLY ANTI-SUBMARINE SEARCHES CLEAR OF HER OPERATING AREA. RECOVER CARRIER AIRCRAFT ABOARD 25 DE MAYO. RETURN ALA FLIGHT TO RIO GRANDE AND ZONDA FLIGHT TO RIO GALLEGOS.

A C-130 TANKER IS ON STATION AT 52 DEGREES SOUTH, BETWEEN 59 AND 60 DEGREES WEST, AT 30,000 FEET. USE IT TO REFUEL THE LAND-BASED STRIKE AIRCRAFT AFTER THE ATTACK. CLIMB FOR THE RETURN TRANSIT AND RENDEZVOUS BEFORE FUEL BECOMES CRITICAL. GIVE PRIORITY TO AIRCRAFT WITH THE LEAST FUEL. THE TANKER IS TO RECOVER AT RIO GALLEGOS.

4. THREAT: EXPECT SEA HARRIER PATROLS, MISSILE-ARMED DESTROYERS AND FRIGATES, AND ANTI-SUBMARINE HELICOPTERS. BRITISH SEARCH AIRCRAFT MAY LOCATE OUR CARRIER OR FOLLOW THE RETURNING STRIKE. DO NOT ALLOW THE CARRIER TO CLOSE UNSUPPORTED WITH THE ENEMY SCREEN.

5. REMARKS: THE BRITISH CARRIER PROVIDES AIR COVER AND STRIKE SUPPORT FOR OPERATIONS AGAINST OUR FORCES ON THE MALVINAS. CONCENTRATE THE AVAILABLE ATTACK WHILE RETAINING THE MEANS TO DEFEND AND RECOVER OUR OWN AIR GROUP. ON COMPLETION, RETIRE WEST WITH THE CARRIER UNDER ESCORT.
